verdict.rationale:
Lovable's core interaction model is delegating build tasks via chat to its built-in AI (Build/Agent mode), which docs describe as taking 'ownership of execution end to end' and allowing users to send follow-ups to steer work while it operates. This directly matches the story of delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant, and is corroborated by community reports of people prototyping apps and CRUD tools by describing tasks in chat.
missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of how autonomously/reliably the assistant completes delegated tasks without user micromanagement.
